introHtml: Pink camping mugs add a pop of color to your outdoor promotions or company picnics. Whether you're coordinating a breast cancer awareness event or just want a fun, eye-catching giveaway, these 15 oz campfire mugs offer a generous capacity for hot coffee or cocoa. The durable enamel or stainless steel construction ensures they hold up to campsite use, while your logo can be imprinted in a contrasting color for maximum visibility. Choose pink to stand out from standard silver or black mugs.
